title: SessionConfig
description: New-session configuration, per plan sections 3.1 and 9.1.

seed.description: null means a random seed is generated and shown after creation (plan section 3.1).

casual_mode.description: Relaxes D6/D8 information rules for beginners; must be stamped on logs/exports (plan section 3.2).

full_procedure_mode.description: Simulates TRP 8.2.2/8.2.3 registration plus deck-build timers.

memory_policy.description: Plan section 8.3. full_recall is deliberately superhuman and must be stamped in the log.

allow_prerelease_hero.description: Default false; Baalghor is pre-release-kit-only (plan S11).
